clue.text: Sword protects leader of Boston Spa from a chessman's breach of Rule 4

indicators.note: the sword wraps round and so shields the next pieces

parts.note: a sabre is a curved cavalry sword

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: Bath is the English spa town
the king is a chess piece

explanation.surface: A swordsman guards a Boston spa visitor from a chess piece that has broken the rules.
explanation.walkthrough: Rule 4 is the fourth commandment, to keep the Sabbath holy, so breaking it is working or playing on the day of rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Desecrating the day of rest violates the fourth of the Ten Commandments, so it is a breach of that rule.

clue.text: Olympian ambassador welcoming student in Greek dialect

indicators.note: the ambassador group sits inside the dialect word

parts.note: Attic is the dialect of ancient Athens

indicators.note: the ambassador takes in the student, enclosing that letter

parts.note: HE is His Excellency, the title of an ambassador
L is the learner plate letter for a student

explanation.surface: An envoy receives a pupil who speaks an ancient Greek dialect.
explanation.definitionFit: An Olympian competitor is sporty and fit, the adjective describing an athlete's build.

clue.text: Dead Russian on the couch

parts.note: Ivan is the stock Russian man's name

explanation.surface: A Russian man lies dead on the sofa.
explanation.definitionFit: A low backless sofa or bed is a couch by another name.

clue.text: Lawrence enters Hell in tramp's religion

indicators.note: the hell-and-Lawrence group goes inside the tramp word

parts.note: a bum is a tramp or vagrant

indicators.note: the writer's initials go inside the underworld word

parts.note: Dis is the classical underworld, hence hell
D. H. Lawrence, the novelist, by his initials

explanation.surface: A novelist goes to the inferno inside a vagrant's faith.
explanation.definitionFit: The faith founded on the teachings of the Buddha is one of the world's major religions.

clue.text: Children taking mariner to a watery grave, perhaps

indicators.note: the offspring word takes in the sailor letters

parts.note: seed is an old word for offspring
AB is an able-bodied seaman

explanation.surface: Children accompany a sailor to his death at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The bottom of the ocean is where drowned sailors lie, so it serves as an example of a watery grave.

clue.text: The commander's rather naughty religious ruling

parts.note: taken as written
OC is Officer Commanding
racy means slightly risque

explanation.surface: An officer's slightly risque behaviour is set against a religious verdict.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Religious ruling' looks like a fatwa-type pronouncement, but it means government by religion.
explanation.definitionFit: Government by priests or in the name of a god is rule on religious lines.

clue.text: Concerning sight of bottle holding American up

indicators.note: the bottle word contains the next piece

parts.note: a vial is a small bottle

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read backwards

explanation.surface: A small bottle with an upturned American flag on it catches the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective meaning relating to the eyes or seeing.

clue.text: Side effect of conflict involving surly gnome and dwarf

indicators.note: involving in its sense of tangling or complicating tells us to mix the letters

explanation.surface: A fight breaks out between a bad-tempered garden ornament and a little person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' joins the two pieces of fodder and is not part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: This illness reported by veterans of the 1991 war in the Gulf is a lasting result of combat.

clue.text: Quality T-bone swallowed by a student, almost

indicators.note: the T-bone pieces go inside the outer letters
the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a tutee is a student who has a tutor
taken as the letter itself
a rib is a bone

explanation.surface: A hungry student nearly finishes a T-bone steak.
explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a characteristic or feature, the noun sense of quality.

clue.text: Japanese product reversed into a Suzuki? A Honda!

indicators.note: the hidden run is read backwards
the letters are found running into these words

explanation.surface: A motoring fan swaps one Japanese bike maker for another.
explanation.walkthrough: The make names suggest a car or motorcycle as the product; it is a poem.
explanation.definitionFit: The short three-line poem is a Japanese literary form, so a cultural product of Japan.

clue.text: Overthrow fat obstacle

indicators.note: over signals that the throw word is turned round

parts.note: to lob is to throw high
lard is pig fat

explanation.surface: Someone tries to topple a heavy barrier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Overthrow' looks like one word meaning topple, but splits into 'over' and 'throw'.
explanation.definitionFit: A short post blocking vehicles from a road is a physical barrier.

clue.text: Foul web untangled by giant-killer

indicators.note: untangling a web rearranges its strands, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A nasty spider's web is cleared by a hero.
explanation.definitionFit: The hero of the Old English epic kills the monster Grendel, a giant, so he is a slayer of giants.

clue.text: Senior Church figure in a skirt

explanation.definitionFit: The archbishop's surname is also the name for a dancer's frilly skirt.

clue.text: Girl kept downstairs (being non-U) going to dance, finally?

definitions.text: Girl kept downstairs (being non-U) going to dance, finally?

parts.words: Girl kept downstairs (being non-U) going to dance, finally?
parts.note: describes the fairy-tale servant kept among the kitchen ashes, low-born, who at last goes to the prince's ball

explanation.walkthrough: Non-U is the 1950s British label for lower-class speech and manners, as against U for upper class.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairy-tale heroine is a scullery girl who finally attends the royal ball.

clue.text: Putting prophet up in model dwelling results in triangular relationship

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a seer foretells the future

explanation.definitionFit: A group of three people, especially three lovers, forms a triangle.

clue.text: Signal to approach amateur footballer

parts.note: to beck is to beckon, signalling someone to come
a ham is an amateur, as in a ham radio operator

explanation.surface: A gesture beckons an amateur player onto the pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: David Beckham is the celebrated England football captain.

clue.text: Chain head-to-tail — they rise when aggravated

indicators.note: the front letter of the chain word goes to its end

parts.note: a shackle is a chain or fetter

explanation.surface: A chain is linked end to end, and tempers flare.
explanation.definitionFit: The hairs on an animal's neck stand up in anger, giving the idiom of getting one's back up.

clue.text: How to secure gardening tool for pastoral feature

indicators.note: the first word holds the tool fast inside it

parts.note: taken as written
an edger trims lawn edges

explanation.surface: A gardener asks how to fasten a garden tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A line of bushes bordering a field is typical of rural scenery.

clue.text: Expression for madman accepting commission on island

indicators.note: the madman word takes in the next pieces

parts.note: a loon is a crazy person
a cut is a share or commission

explanation.surface: A lunatic takes a percentage on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A locution is a word or phrase, a form of expression.

clue.text: Springtime visitor from afar catching flower and fish

indicators.note: the alien wraps around the flower

parts.note: ET, the extraterrestrial
an aster is a daisy-like flower
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An alien arrives in spring and picks a bloom and a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The season of Easter falls in spring, so it is a spring period.

clue.text: Feel very cross with girl keeping support up

parts.note: a golf tee supports the ball

clue.text: Office worker reported Siamese drunk

parts.note: Siamese means Thai, and pissed is slang for drunk

clue.text: Survey that's less than barely adequate

indicators.note: the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: scant means barely enough

explanation.surface: A survey proves less than sufficient.
explanation.definitionFit: To scan is to look over or examine, the verb sense of survey.

clue.text: Cross and unsettled

definitions.meaning: disputed and unresolved, as in a much-debated question

explanation.definitionFit: Vexed means annoyed and also, of a question, hotly disputed and unresolved.

clue.text: Monarch born to drink and revel

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king
nee means born, before a maiden name
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: A king is born to drink and party.
explanation.walkthrough: A knees-up is British slang for a lively party.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy party or celebration is a revel.

clue.text: Muscle of sorts for virtual church servant?

parts.note: E- means electronic or virtual, as in e-mail

clue.text: Divine messenger taking human form

explanation.surface: A heavenly messenger appears in human shape.

explanation.definitionFit: Nahum is an Old Testament prophet, a messenger of God.

clue.text: Old black god taking time to go back into the pantry
